description_en: Queries the current and effective configurations of a workflow node
description_zh: 查询工作流节点的当前配置与生效配置
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo get-workflow-node-configuration --collaboration-group-id cg_9401 --instance-id inst_2081 --node-id node_7f3a2c --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetWorkflowNodeConfiguration

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID；缺省使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the collaboration workspace
parameters.name: collaboration_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the current physical plan (planId)
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The key of the business node (nodeKey)
parameters.name: node_id

canEdit.description_en: Indicates whether the current user can edit this node
canEdit.description_zh: 当前用户是否可编辑此节点

configVersion.description_en: The configuration version. It is used as the expectedVersion when updating or restoring the configuration
configVersion.description_zh: 配置版本；更新或恢复时作为expectedVersion

defaultExecutor.description_en: The default executor of the template

id.description_en: The ID of the executor. If the type is USER, this is a positive integer string representing the platform user ID. If the type is AGENT, this is the technical name of the digital employee in the workspace
id.description_zh: USER 为正整数平台用户ID字符串；AGENT 为空间数字员工技术名称

type.description_en: The type of the executor. Valid values: USER for a real person, AGENT for a digital employee, and SYSTEM for a legacy system executor. The SYSTEM value is used only in responses
type.description_zh: USER 真人、AGENT 数字员工或历史 SYSTEM 系统执行人；SYSTEM仅用于响应

defaultModel.description_en: The default model runtime profile of the template

defaultResponsibleUserIds.description_en: The list of user IDs for the default responsible users of the template
defaultResponsibleUserIds.description_zh: 模板默认负责人用户ID列表

items.description_en: The platform user ID of a default responsible user for the template
items.description_zh: 模板默认负责人的平台用户ID

id.description_en: The ID of the executor. If the type is USER, this is a positive integer string representing the platform user ID. If the type is AGENT, this is the technical name of the digital employee in the workspace
id.description_zh: USER 为正整数平台用户ID字符串；AGENT 为空间数字员工技术名称

type.description_en: The type of the executor. Valid values: USER for a real person, AGENT for a digital employee, and SYSTEM for a legacy system executor. The SYSTEM value is used only in responses
type.description_zh: USER 真人、AGENT 数字员工或历史 SYSTEM 系统执行人；SYSTEM仅用于响应

effectiveModel.description_en: The currently effective model runtime profile
effectiveModel.description_zh: 当前生效的模型运行档

effectiveResponsibleUserIds.description_en: The list of user IDs for the currently effective responsible users
effectiveResponsibleUserIds.description_zh: 当前生效的负责人用户ID列表

items.description_en: The platform user ID of a currently effective responsible user
items.description_zh: 当前生效负责人的平台用户ID

instanceId.description_en: The ID of the current physical plan

nodeId.description_en: The key of the business node

overrides.description_en: The override values for the instance. If a field is null, the default value of the template is used
overrides.description_zh: 实例覆盖值；字段为null时使用模板默认值

executor.description_en: The override executor. A null value indicates that the default is used

id.description_en: The ID of the executor. If the type is USER, this is a positive integer string representing the platform user ID. If the type is AGENT, this is the technical name of the digital employee in the workspace
id.description_zh: USER 为正整数平台用户ID字符串；AGENT 为空间数字员工技术名称

type.description_en: The type of the executor. Valid values: USER for a real person, AGENT for a digital employee, and SYSTEM for a legacy system executor. The SYSTEM value is used only in responses
type.description_zh: USER 真人、AGENT 数字员工或历史 SYSTEM 系统执行人；SYSTEM仅用于响应

model.description_en: The override model runtime profile. A null value indicates that the default is used
model.description_zh: 覆盖模型运行档；null为默认

responsibleUserIds.description_en: The list of override responsible user IDs. A null value indicates that the default is used
responsibleUserIds.description_zh: 覆盖负责人ID列表；null为默认

items.description_en: The platform user ID of an override responsible user for the instance
items.description_zh: 实例覆盖负责人的平台用户ID

stateVersion.description_en: The state refresh cursor. This cannot be used as a configuration version
stateVersion.description_zh: 状态刷新游标，不能作为配置版本

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the configuration was last updated, in ISO 8601 format. This field is empty if the configuration has never been updated
updatedAt.description_zh: 最后配置更新时间ISO8601；从未更新时为空

updatedBy.description_en: The platform user ID of the user who last updated the configuration. This field is empty if the configuration has never been updated
updatedBy.description_zh: 最后更新配置的平台用户ID；从未更新时为空
